WITH buckets AS ( SELECT 1 AS ord, '20대' AS label FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 2, '30대' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 3, '40대' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 4, '50대+' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 5, '미입력' FROM dual ), base AS ( SELECT u.USER_ID, CASE WHEN u.USER_BIR IS NULL OR u.USER_BIR <= DATE '1900-01-01' or u.USER_BIR > SYSDATE THEN '미입력' ELSE CASE WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, u.USER_BIR) / 12) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, u.USER_BIR) / 12) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, u.USER_BIR) / 12) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, u.USER_BIR) / 12) >= 50 THEN '50대+' ELSE '미입력' END END AS bucket FROM USERS u WHERE
), agg AS ( SELECT bucket AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM base GROUP BY bucket ) SELECT b.label AS label, NVL(a.value, 0) AS value FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.label = b.label ORDER BY b.ord

WITH buckets AS ( SELECT 1 AS ord, '5~100만원' AS label FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 2, '101~200만원' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 3, '201~300만원' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 4, '301~500만원' FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 5, '기타' FROM dual ), totals AS ( SELECT u.USER_ID, SUM(p.PAY_AMOUNT) AS totalPaid FROM USERS u JOIN ORDERS o ON o.USER_ID = u.USER_ID JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO AND p.PAY_STATUS = 'PAID' AND WHERE TRIM(UPPER(NVL(u.ROLE,'USER'))) = 'USER' GROUP BY u.USER_ID HAVING NVL(SUM(p.PAY_AMOUNT), 0) > 0 ), tagged AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN totalPaid >= 50000 AND totalPaid < 1000000 THEN '5~100만원' WHEN totalPaid >= 1000000 AND totalPaid < 2000000 THEN '101~200만원' WHEN totalPaid >= 2000000 AND totalPaid < 3000000 THEN '201~300만원' WHEN totalPaid >= 3000000 AND totalPaid < 5000000 THEN '301~500만원' ELSE '기타' END AS bucket FROM totals ), agg AS ( SELECT bucket AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM tagged GROUP BY bucket ) SELECT b.label AS label, NVL(a.value, 0) AS value FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.label = b.label ORDER BY b.ord
